scope: Discloud PostgreSQL and isolated Aiven PG18 schemas; existing Supabase source remains authoritative and is not modified by this registry

public.dank_verify_reminder_delivery.feature: Simple Verify per-guild reminder attempt counters
public.dank_verify_reminder_delivery.purpose: Prevent duplicate pings and enforce per-member limits across restarts
public.dank_verify_reminder_delivery.retention_rule: Retain while Discord membership remains; after at least 90 days idle delete only on authoritative Discord Unknown Member (10007), with joined_at and last_claimed_at guards
public.dank_verify_reminder_delivery.preserve_when: Member still in guild; guild unavailable; Discord cannot definitively prove departure; database/query error
public.dank_verify_reminder_delivery.historical_reuse: Enforce this member's per-join reminder cap after restarts; never infer hostile behavior from an incomplete verification alone

dank_migration.staged_records.feature: One-shot verified Supabase-to-Discloud transfer staging; not live bot data
dank_migration.staged_records.owner: tools.stage_dankshield_core_data; explicitly invoked private deployment operator
dank_migration.staged_records.purpose: Temporarily hold copied critical Dank Shield configuration, access and ticket records while PG17 repository parity and cutover are verified
dank_migration.staged_records.retention_rule: No automatic expiry or deletion. Preserve until an independently verified encrypted export, source/target row parity and successful rollback/cutover test; then delete only after explicit authorized operator approval.
dank_migration.staged_records.expiry_index: primary key (source_table, record_key); no TTL index because data cannot be expired automatically
dank_migration.staged_records.preserve_when: Source data changes during copy; verification incomplete; Discloud storage headroom insufficient; rollback still required; private database unavailable
dank_migration.staged_records.historical_reuse: Restore original server configurations and access/ticket states during staged repository conversion; never authorize activity cleanup from copied unverified data

dank_core.guild_config_shadow.feature: Isolated, verified PostgreSQL 17 shadow of canonical guild settings; not live
dank_core.guild_config_shadow.purpose: Verify original guild configuration rows and stable per-row hashes before building the new live repository
dank_core.guild_config_shadow.retention_rule: No timed expiry or automatic deletion. Preserve the source payload until independently verified PostgreSQL runtime parity, backup/restore and controlled rollout; never modify current Supabase or voice-bot state.
dank_core.guild_config_shadow.preserve_when: Any source row hash differs, migrations or data parity are incomplete, rollback is still required, database/storage budget is unknown, or voice-bot isolation is unverified
dank_core.guild_config_shadow.historical_reuse: Full-fidelity comparison and recovery of original guild settings, including roles, channels, setup/verification, and ticket choices; no automatic member cleanup

dank_core.guild_config_state.feature: Future atomic PostgreSQL guild configuration, disabled on live runtime until tested cutover
dank_core.guild_config_state.purpose: One authoritative current per-guild JSON row with lock-serialized sparse updates, revision CAS and no-op write suppression
dank_core.guild_config_state.retention_rule: Never expire or automatically delete configured guild records; archive only after authoritative offboarding, verified backup and explicit owner-approved data retention review
dank_core.guild_config_state.expiry_index: primary key (guild_id); no automatic expiry because guild configuration is durable
dank_core.guild_config_state.preserve_when: Bot offline, guild membership unavailable, database errors, backup/restore unverified, any active server, any unconfirmed ownership or retention status
dank_core.guild_config_state.historical_reuse: Durable current settings, setup, verification and protected role/channel choices; monotonically increasing revision for CAS and safe rollback

dank_archive.original_rows.feature: Guarded Aiven PostgreSQL 18 lossless historical data preservation
dank_archive.original_rows.owner: tools.aiven_history_archive; explicitly invoked owner-only GitHub Actions archive workflow
dank_archive.original_rows.purpose: Preserve all original Dank Shield configuration history, moderation logs, activity feed and invite-block evidence in compressed, digest-verified private storage without duplicating those payloads in future live indexes
dank_archive.original_rows.retention_rule: No automatic expiration, cleanup, archive rewrites or deletion. Retain all original rows until a fresh independently restorable encrypted off-database backup, exact history parity, explicit legal/privacy retention review and separately authorized data lifecycle migration are verified.
dank_archive.original_rows.expiry_index: primary key (source_table, record_key) and (guild_id,event_at desc); no TTL/expiry index or active cleanup worker
dank_archive.original_rows.preserve_when: All original moderation/security history, incident evidence, source/target parity pending, missing backup or restore drill, source changes after snapshot, unknown consent or active guild/user dependencies
dank_archive.original_rows.historical_reuse: Recover original byte-exact PostgreSQL JSON text with SHA-256 and zlib verification; reconstruct original feed display metadata, config changes and security incidents without lossy deduplication
